claims.supported_claim: Choose Task<T>, no default pooling, two-phase startup with explicit NoRegistration/StartSkipped/Rejected/AcceptedReturned sentinels and conservative Indeterminate quarantine; terminal-driven outcome with a preallocated binding-failure latch; callback-external typed take; bounded autonomous cleanup and separate managed/native retirement guards.
limitations: Model assumes several protocol transitions; it does not verify result ownership transfer, coordinator boundedness, weak memory or real implementation.

Cross-review clarified setup compensation, callback binding failure and managed dispatcher drain; these additional paths are design obligations, not covered by the current finite model or runtime tests.
